_about: Component identifier (Design › Components). tab = short name on the drawing picker. spots = tap targets on the enlarged drawing, [number on the drawing (or component name where the drawing labels by name), x, y, width, height] in image pixels. Drawings are cropped from the manufacturer manuals (page = printed page; images in public/components/, made by components.py in the project files; parts views are the J-series and K-series exploded views already in public/parts/; k-comp-cycle is made by the K-series build notes in the project files). Each component: name (manual wording), does (what it is, in plain words, from the manual pages in src), at = [drawing id, number on that drawing] (number null = labelled by name on the drawing), faults = fault codes that point to it, parts = parts list ref numbers (J-series: the number; K-series, J T-Cap and L-series: list:ref, e.g. o0509:3, w:25 or in:51, lists as in k-series-parts.json, t-cap-parts.json and l-series-parts.json), wiring = wiring diagram ids, src = manual pages.

components.name: PCB (water side main PCB)
components.does: The main control board for the water side. It runs the pump, back-up heater and 3-way valve, and has the field terminals for the room thermostat, sensors and remote controller. The refrigerant side has its own PCB.

components.name: Single phase RCCB (main power)
components.does: Residual current breaker for power supply 1 (the heat pump). Test it with the TEST button while powered: the lever drops to 0 if it works. Set it back to ON after.

components.name: Single phase RCCB (back-up heater)
components.does: Residual current breaker for power supply 2 (the back-up heater). Tested the same way as the main RCCB.

components.name: Heat exchanger (plate)
components.does: Brazed plate heat exchanger where the refrigerant hands its heat to the heating water (the condenser in heating).

components.name: Water pressure gauge
components.does: Shows the heating circuit water pressure. Normal running is 0.05 to 0.3 MPa (0.5 to 3 bar). If it's below 0.05 MPa, top up the system.

components.name: Water pump
components.does: DC circulating pump that moves the water through the unit and the heating system. Maximum flow with the main pump running must reach the nominal flow for the unit's size, and never under 15 l/min (check under Service setup › Pump max speed).

components.name: Cabinet top plate
components.does: Top panel of the cabinet.

components.name: Expansion vessel
components.does: Built-in 6 L vessel with 1 bar initial pressure. It covers up to 150 L of system water without antifreeze. Above that, fit an extra vessel (field supply). With antifreeze, work it out from the formula in the manual.

components.name: Flow sensor (water flow switch)
components.does: Electronic flow sensor. It shuts the unit down when the flow drops below 7 l/min (or reads 69 l/min or more).

components.name: Heater assembly (back-up heater)
components.does: Integrated electric back-up heater, 3 kW, on its own supply (power supply 2) and RCCB.

components.name: Overload protector (2 pieces)
components.does: Thermal cut-outs on the back-up heater (Detail A). They trip if the water overheats. To reset, take off the cover and push the centre button gently with a test pen.

components.name: Pressure relief valve
components.does: Heating circuit safety valve: opens at 300 kPa (3 bar), closes at 210 kPa. Check it by turning the lever horizontal: you should hear water discharge. Set the lever down when filling.

components.name: Air purge valve
components.does: Automatic air vent. Turn the plug on the outlet anticlockwise one full turn from closed and leave it there to vent air automatically.

components.name: Magnetic water filter set
components.does: Filter on the water inlet that catches dirt and magnetite. Clean it after the test run.

components.name: Plug (2 pieces)
components.does: Blanking plugs on the rear of the unit.

components.name: Bushing (7 pieces)
components.does: Cable entry bushings on the rear of the unit.

components.name: Cabinet front plate
components.does: Front panel over the electrical side. Take it off to reach the terminal boards for the power cables.

components.name: Cover (2 pieces)
components.does: Side access covers.

components.name: Water inlet
components.does: Return from the heating system into the unit. 1¼ inch connection.

components.name: Water outlet
components.does: Flow out of the unit to the heating system. 1¼ inch connection.

components.name: Compressor
components.does: Compresses the refrigerant (R32) gas, driven by the inverter on the refrigerant PCB.

components.name: 4-way valve
components.does: Reverses the refrigerant flow to change between heating, and cooling or defrost. Switched by its V-coil.

components.name: Expansion valve
components.does: Electronic expansion valve that meters the refrigerant, with a strainer either side. A clogged valve or strainer is one cause of H42.

components.name: High pressure sensor
components.does: Reads the refrigerant high side pressure for the refrigerant PCB (connector CN-HPS).

components.name: Pressure switch
components.does: High pressure safety switch on the compressor discharge. Never bridge it.

components.name: Outdoor heat exchanger (coil)
components.does: Finned outdoor coil. In heating it takes heat from the outside air.

components.name: Receiver and muffler
components.does: Receiver holds liquid refrigerant; the muffler quietens the compressor discharge.

components.name: Air temp. sensor (outdoor air)
components.does: Outdoor air temperature sensor.

components.name: Pipe temp. sensor (outdoor heat exchanger)
components.does: Outdoor heat exchanger pipe temperature sensor.

components.name: Eva exit temp. sensor
components.does: Evaporator outlet temperature sensor.

components.name: Compressor discharge temp. sensor
components.does: Measures the refrigerant temperature leaving the compressor.

components.name: Compressor tank temp. sensor
components.does: Compressor body temperature sensor.

components.name: Ref pipe temp. sensor
components.does: Refrigerant liquid temperature sensor at the plate heat exchanger.

components.name: Water inlet temp. sensor
components.does: Return water temperature into the plate heat exchanger.

components.name: Hex water outlet temp. sensor
components.does: Water temperature straight out of the plate heat exchanger, before the back-up heater.

components.name: Water outlet temp. sensor
components.does: Flow temperature leaving the unit, after the back-up heater.

components.name: Fan motor and propeller fan
components.does: Outdoor fan that draws air through the coil (ref 38 motor, ref 40 fan).

components.name: Refrigerant side main PCB
components.does: Inverter board for the refrigerant side: drives the compressor and fan and reads the refrigerant sensors. It carries the IPM (power transistor). The part number differs by model.

components.name: Remote controller
components.does: Wired controller. Cable 2 × min 0.3 mm² double insulated, max 50 m.

components.does: Heating circuit safety valve. Check it by turning the lever horizontal: you should hear water discharge. Push the lever down after checking, and set it down when filling. The spec table lists it as opens at 800 kPa and closes at 640 kPa and below (T-Cap SM p.12, p.15). This is the T-Cap's own spec: don't use it for other units.

components.name: Compressor
components.does: Inverter compressor (9RD220XBC21 on the 5, 7 and 9 kW; 9RD138ZAB21 on the 3 kW). It won't restart for 3 minutes after stopping and runs at least 30 seconds once started. Over 112 °C compressor tank temperature it stops (F20). For F14, F23 and F41, check the U, V, W connections and the winding resistance U-V, V-W, W-U with the harnesses off.

components.name: Fan motor
components.does: DC fan motor (60 W on the 5-9 kW, 40 W on the 3 kW) turning the propeller fan. It stops during deice. For F15: power off and turn the fan by hand; then check the outdoor PCB output to the motor: about 325 V DC (pins 1 and 4), 15 V DC (pins 5 and 4), and 1-5 V DC rotation command (pins 7 and 4). A fan that isn't running is also a cause of F22 and H42.

components.name: Propeller fan
components.does: Fan blade on the fan motor shaft. With the power off it should turn freely by hand (F15 check).

components.name: Outdoor heat exchanger (coil)
components.does: The outdoor coil (CONDENSER in the parts list). Dust on the coil or discharged air short-circuiting back to the intake is a listed cause of H42 and F12: clean it and clear the airflow.

components.name: 4-way valve
components.does: Reverses the refrigerant flow for deice and cooling. For F25, check the valve coil is connected, the coil continuity, and the CN-HOT voltage during heating.

components.name: 4-way valve coil (V-coil)
components.does: Coil on the 4-way valve, plugged into CN-HOT on the outdoor PCB. F25 check: with the harness off CN-HOT, about 1.52 kΩ across it.

components.name: High pressure sensor (CN-HPS)
components.does: Measures the refrigerant high pressure, plugged into CN-HPS on the outdoor PCB. H64 if its signal reads 0 V or 5 V: check CN-HPS, then the DC voltage between pins 1 and 3 (GND). Also used for the H27, H98/F95 and F24 checks.

components.name: High pressure switch
components.does: PRESSURE SWITCH in the parts list, plugged into CN-PSW1 on the outdoor PCB. It opens at 4.5 MPa and above (F12). With the compressor stopped it should have continuity; if it stays open you get F27.

components.name: Expansion valve
components.does: Electronic expansion valve in the liquid line. A clogged expansion valve or strainer is a listed cause of H42, H98, F12, F20 and F24.

components.name: Expansion valve coil
components.does: Coil that drives the expansion valve.

components.name: Strainer
components.does: Refrigerant strainers either side of the expansion valve (2 fitted). A clogged strainer is a listed cause of H42, H98, F20 and F24.

components.name: Receiver
components.does: Refrigerant receiver (5, 7 and 9 kW).

components.name: Discharge muffler
components.does: Silencer on the compressor discharge line. The 3 kW has two (refs 20 and 21 in its list).

components.name: Muffler (3 kW only)
components.does: Muffler in the liquid line at the outdoor coil, shown on the cycle diagram for the WH-UDZ03KE5 only.

components.name: 3-way valve (gas service valve)
components.does: Gas pipe service valve, with the service port for gauges and vacuum. Gas pipe 1/2" (55 N·m) on the 3 kW, 5/8" (65 N·m) on the 5-9 kW. It must be fully open: a closed valve gives H27 and is a listed cause of F12, F24 and F46.

components.name: 2-way valve (liquid service valve)
components.does: Liquid pipe service valve, 1/4" pipe, 18 N·m. A partly closed valve is a listed cause of H42.

components.name: Compressor tank temperature sensor (CN-TANK)
components.does: Measures the compressor shell temperature, plugged into CN-TANK on the outdoor PCB (5, 7 and 9 kW list). Over 112 °C the compressor stops (F20). For H15, check CN-TANK and compare the resistance with the chart on p.212.

components.name: Discharge temperature sensor (CN-DIS)
components.does: Measures the compressor discharge pipe temperature, plugged into CN-DIS on the outdoor PCB. Check CN-DIS and compare the resistance with the chart.

components.name: Outdoor air and pipe temperature sensors (CN-TH1)
components.does: One harness with the outdoor air sensor and the outdoor pipe (coil) sensor, plugged into CN-TH1 on the outdoor PCB. The pipe sensor and air sensor decide when deice starts. Check CN-TH1 and compare the resistance with the charts on p.250 (air) and p.254 (pipe).

components.name: Eva exit / bypass outlet temperature sensor (CN-TH3)
components.does: Sensor at the outdoor coil outlet (EVA. EXIT TEMP. SENSOR on the cycle diagram), plugged into CN-TH3 on the outdoor PCB. The F49 check (outdoor bypass outlet temperature sensor) is on CN-TH3.

components.name: Outdoor PCB (electronic controller main)
components.does: Main outdoor control board: compressor inverter (IPM), fan motor drive, current transformer, and the sensor and valve connectors (CN-TH1, CN-TH3, CN-DIS, CN-TANK, CN-HPS, CN-PSW, CN-HOT). Part number differs on every model. Many outdoor checks end with "replace the outdoor unit PCB (main)" once wiring, supply, sensors and refrigerant check out.

components.name: Reactor
components.does: Reactor (choke) in the outdoor unit power circuit, shown on the block diagram.

components.name: Terminal board (1, 2, 3)
components.does: Indoor/outdoor connecting cable terminals 1, 2, 3 and earth. Cable: 4-core 1.5 mm² on the 3 and 5 kW, 4-core 2.5 mm² on the 7 and 9 kW, type 60245 IEC 57 or heavier; earth longer than the other cores; strip 10 ± 1 mm. Wrong wiring or a broken core gives H90; check 230 V supply for H95.

components.name: Discharge grille
components.does: Fan guard on the 5, 7 and 9 kW, fitted on site with the metal plates and screws supplied. Fit it before powering on.

components.name: Hot water cylinder (tank)
components.does: The domestic hot water tank inside the unit (TANK COMPLETE in the parts list).

components.name: Refrigerant to water heat exchanger
components.does: Plate heat exchanger where the refrigerant from the outdoor unit heats the system water. In the parts list it is ref 28, HOT WATER COIL - COMPLETE. H99 is the freeze prevention code for it.

components.name: Water inlet / outlet temperature sensors (CN-TH1)
components.does: Water inlet and outlet temperature sensors on CN-TH1 of the main PCB (one part, SENSOR - CO. (WATER IN OUT, REF TEMP SENSOR CN-TH1)). F37 is the inlet sensor, F45 the outlet sensor.

components.name: Drain valve
components.does: Drain valve on the tank.

components.name: Back-up heater thermostat
components.does: THERMOSTAT in the parts list, fitted 2 on the K3E5 and 3 on the K6E5.

components.name: Hydraulic module
components.does: The water side of the unit: plate heat exchanger, pump, flow switch, expansion vessel, bleed valve and safety valve. See the hydraulic module drawings.

components.name: Compressor
components.does: Compresses the refrigerant (R290). On the 8, 11 and 13 kW, the compressor transport support must be removed at installation, or the warranty is void.

components.name: Automatic bleed valve
components.does: Automatic air vent at the top of the hydraulic module. Vent fully after filling.

components.name: Water inlet pipe
components.does: Heating return into the unit. Fit the supplied Y filter on the inlet (a sediment filter is mandatory), observing the flow direction.

components.name: Expansion vessel
components.does: Listed as 8 L, with 5 effective litres and 1.5 bar factory pre-charge. Check the pre-charge every two years. External vessel sizing tables on p.42.

components.name: Refrigerant gas pipe
components.does: Refrigerant gas line to the plate heat exchanger. Refrigerant work only by F-Gas certified personnel; R290 is highly flammable.

components.name: Temperature sensor
components.does: Water and refrigerant temperature sensors on the plate heat exchanger pipework: Tw_in (heating return), Tw_out (heating flow), T2 and T2B (refrigerant). Resistance tables on p.15.

components.name: Refrigerant pipe
components.does: Refrigerant liquid line to the plate heat exchanger.

components.name: Flow switch
components.does: Stops the unit on low water flow. Setpoint 6 ±1 l/min (4, 6 and 8 kW), 10 ±1 l/min (11 and 13 kW). Before first fill, remove it (turn anticlockwise), dry it and refit with the arrow pointing towards the pump: factory test water can freeze in it. Terminal CN8 (FS) on the Main Control PCB.

components.name: Circulating pump
components.does: Variable speed pump for the heating circuit: power on CN28 (PUMP), speed signal on CN17 (PUMP_BP).

components.name: Plate heat exchanger
components.does: Where the refrigerant hands its heat to the heating water (the condenser in heating). It has a heat tape against freezing.

components.name: Water outlet pipe
components.does: Heating flow out of the unit.

components.name: Safety pressure relief valve
components.does: 3 bar safety valve on the heating circuit. Pipe its outlet to the condensate drain hole. Check it works once a year.

components.name: Compressor discharge temperature sensor Tp
components.does: Refrigerant temperature leaving the compressor (high pressure side). Terminal CN50.

components.name: Compressor intake temperature sensor Th
components.does: Suction temperature into the compressor (low pressure side). Terminal CN5.

components.name: High-pressure switch
components.does: Safety switch on the high pressure side. Never bridge it.

components.name: High-pressure sensor (H-SEN)
components.does: Reads the high side pressure (0-5 V, terminal CN3). Swapped with the low pressure sensor gives P27.

components.name: 4-way valve
components.does: Reverses the refrigerant flow for cooling and defrost.

components.name: Low pressure sensor (L-SEN)
components.does: Reads the low side pressure (0-5 V, terminal CN46).

components.name: Outdoor air temperature sensor T4
components.does: Outdoor air temperature at the coil. Terminal CN45. Take care of it when removing the heat exchanger protection at installation.

components.name: Finned heat exchanger
components.does: Outdoor coil: the evaporator in heating, taking heat from the air.

components.name: Heat exchanger temperature sensor T3
components.does: Outdoor coil temperature (bottom of the coil). Terminal CN34.

components.name: Heat exchanger outlet refrigerant temperature sensor TL
components.does: Refrigerant temperature at the outdoor coil outlet (used in cooling). Terminal CN7.

components.name: Filter (refrigerant)
components.does: Refrigerant filters either side of the expansion valve.

components.name: Electronic expansion valve
components.does: Meters the refrigerant (EEV2, terminal CN44).

components.name: Refrigerant temperature sensor T2
components.does: Refrigerant temperature at the plate heat exchanger (used in cooling). Terminal CN47. The manual's code list and p.15 disagree on which of T2 and T2B is inlet and outlet.

components.name: Liquid receiver
components.does: Holds liquid refrigerant.

components.name: Heating return temperature sensor Tw_in
components.does: Return water temperature into the plate heat exchanger. Terminal CN10.

components.name: Heat tape (plate heat exchanger)
components.does: Heating tape on the plate heat exchanger and expansion vessel, against freezing.

components.name: Plate heat exchanger outlet refrigerant temperature sensor T2B
components.does: Refrigerant gas side temperature at the plate heat exchanger (used in cooling). Terminal CN47.

components.name: Heating flow temperature sensor Tw_out
components.does: Flow water temperature out of the plate heat exchanger. Terminal CN10.

components.name: Casing
components.does: Indoor control unit casing.

components.name: Upper front cover
components.does: Upper front cover of the indoor control unit.

components.name: User interface cover
components.does: Flap over the controller screen.

components.name: User interface
components.does: The controller screen with [Back], [Menu] and the dial.

components.name: Bottom front cover
components.does: Remove to reach the PCBs and terminal blocks.

components.name: SCB-17B PCB
components.does: Expansion board to control an additional heating circuit. The main pump is powered through it (X27).

components.name: Feedthrough cable gland
components.does: Cable entry.

components.name: TsTsXYE terminal block
components.does: Bus connection to the outdoor unit (XYE) and sensor terminals.

components.name: BUS cable earth connection
components.does: Earth for the shielded bus cable.

components.name: Cable clamp
components.does: Cable clamps.

components.name: L-BUS bus terminator
components.does: Terminator for the L-Bus.

components.name: CB-21 PCB
components.does: Connection board (CB-21).

components.name: EHC-16 main PCB
components.does: Main control board for the heat pump and the first heating circuit. X24 230 V supply, X25 heating/DHW 3-way valve, X16 outdoor unit bus, X12 options (thermostat, BL inputs), X28 outdoor and DHW sensors.

L.note: Tank unit drawing and the refrigeration and water cycle diagram from the L-series service manual (WH-ADC0509L3E51 with WH-WDG05/07/09LE5); the exploded views are from its parts lists, and their numbers are the parts list ref numbers. The plate heat exchanger, pressure relief valve and air separator are in the outdoor unit; the expansion vessel, back-up heater, pump and flow sensor are in the tank unit.

components.name: Remote controller
components.does: Wired controller on the front of the tank unit. It can be moved to a room (1-1.5 m from the floor) and used as the room thermostat; cable 2 x 0.3 mm², up to 50 m.

components.name: Left decoration panel
components.does: Front trim panel, left. Push it off from behind to get at the remote controller holder.

components.name: Right decoration panel
components.does: Front trim panel, right.

components.name: Water pump
components.does: Circulating pump for the heating circuit, in the tank unit. Check it runs after filling. Maximum flow with the main pump running must reach the nominal flow for the unit's size, and never under 15 l/min (Service setup › Pump maximum speed).

components.name: Control board cover
components.does: Cover over the control board. Only qualified electricians work behind it.

components.name: Control board
components.does: Electrical box holding the main PCB, RCCBs and terminal boards. Power and connecting cables come in through the bushing at its base.

components.name: Main PCB
components.does: Tank unit main circuit board. Field wiring (valves, thermostat, sensors, remote controller, boiler contact, extra pump) goes to its terminal block.

components.name: RCCB/ELCB, main power
components.does: Single phase RCCB/ELCB for power supply 1 (main power, 3 x 2.5 mm², 25 A). Test it with the power on at commissioning and set it back ON.

components.name: RCCB/ELCB, back-up heater
components.does: Single phase RCCB/ELCB for power supply 2 (back-up heater, 3 x 1.5 mm², 15/16 A).

components.name: Magnetic water filter set
components.does: Magnetic filter on the heating return. Clean it after the test run and at service: power off, remove the magnet bar, open the service valve to flush into a container.

components.name: Back-up heater (heater assembly)
components.does: 3 kW electric back-up heater in the heating circuit, on power supply 2. Protected by the overload protector.

components.name: 3-way valve
components.does: Switches the flow between space heating and the DHW tank coil.

components.name: Overload protector (OLP)
components.does: Safety thermostat on the back-up heater (85 °C). If it trips at high water temperature, take off the cover and push the centre button with a test pen to reset it.

components.name: Expansion vessel
components.does: Built-in 10 L heating expansion vessel, 1 bar pre-charge. Good for up to 200 L of system water; add a vessel above that.

components.name: Drain plug
components.does: Drain point on the tank unit water circuit.

components.name: Tank
components.does: Built-in DHW cylinder, 127 L (120 L net), stainless.

components.name: Flow sensor
components.does: Measures the heating water flow (5-60 l/min). No flow or low flow gives H62: release the air and check the pump and filter.

components.name: Water pressure sensor
components.does: Pressure transducer (0-4 bar) for the heating water. Read it on the controller: System check › System information › Water pressure. Normal 0.5-3 bar.

components.name: Front plate
components.does: Front panel of the tank unit. Remove the 2 screws and slide it up to open.

components.name: Top plate
components.does: Top panel of the tank unit.

components.name: Right plate
components.does: Right side panel.

components.name: Left plate
components.does: Left side panel.

components.name: Rear plate
components.does: Rear panel.

components.name: Tank sensor
components.does: DHW tank temperature sensor (not visible, in the tank).

components.name: Bushing
components.does: Cable bushings (4) at the base of the control board. They must be used.

components.name: Safety relief valve (DHW)
components.does: DHW tank safety relief valve. Turn the knob anticlockwise for 10 s to release air after filling, and regularly to keep the discharge clear of lime.

components.name: Network adaptor holder
components.does: Holder for the optional network adaptor (connects to CN-CNT on the main PCB).

components.name: Compressor
components.does: R290 rotary compressor in the outdoor unit.

components.name: 4-way valve
components.does: Reverses the refrigerant flow for defrost and cooling. Coil is a separate part.

components.name: Expansion valve
components.does: Electronic expansion valve controlling the refrigerant flow. A blocked valve or strainer shows as H42, F20 or H98.

components.name: Strainer
components.does: Refrigerant strainers either side of the expansion valve.

components.name: Outdoor heat exchanger (condenser)
components.does: Outdoor air coil. Keep it clear for air flow.

components.name: Pipe temp. sensor
components.does: Outdoor heat exchanger pipe sensor (CN-TH1, same part as the air temp. sensor).

components.name: Air temp. sensor (outdoor air)
components.does: Outdoor air temperature sensor (CN-TH1).

components.name: Evaporator outlet temp. sensor
components.does: Sensor on the evaporator outlet (CN-TH3).

components.name: High pressure sensor
components.does: Refrigerant high pressure sensor (CN-HPS).

components.name: Pressure switch
components.does: High pressure safety switch (CN-PSW).

components.name: Discharge temp. sensor
components.does: Compressor discharge pipe sensor (CN-DIS).

components.name: Receiver (refrigerant)
components.does: Refrigerant receiver in the outdoor unit. Not the heating expansion vessel, which is in the tank unit.

components.name: Refrigerant temp. sensor
components.does: Refrigerant liquid temperature sensor at the plate heat exchanger (CN-TH4).

components.name: Hot water coil (plate heat exchanger)
components.does: Refrigerant-to-water plate heat exchanger. On the L-series it is in the outdoor unit, so only water pipes run to the house.

components.name: Water outlet temp. sensor 2
components.does: Water outlet sensor in the outdoor unit (CN-TH4).

components.name: Water inlet temp. sensor 2
components.does: Water inlet sensor in the outdoor unit (CN-TH4).

components.name: Water outlet temp. sensor
components.does: Water outlet temperature sensor in the tank unit (thermistor on the main PCB). Its fault code is F45.

components.name: Water inlet temp. sensor
components.does: Water inlet (return) temperature sensor in the tank unit (thermistor on the main PCB). Its fault code is F37.

components.name: Water discharge valve
components.does: Drain point on the water circuit, shown on the cycle diagram. Use it to drain the water side for servicing.

components.name: Service valve
components.does: Refrigerant service valve on the outdoor unit. R290: recovery only by certified personnel with a leak detector on, ATEX rated equipment and no ignition source within 3 m.

components.name: Air separator
components.does: Separates air from the water in the outdoor unit. Don't fit automatic air vents on the indoor water pipes: if R290 leaked into the water it could get indoors.

components.name: Pressure relief valve
components.does: Heating circuit relief valve, mounted in the outdoor unit. Pipe its 15 mm drain hose downwards to open, frost-free air. Test it at commissioning by pulling the lever horizontal.

components.name: Water filter (outdoor)
components.does: Water filter in the outdoor unit. Clean it with the magnetic filter after the test run.

components.name: Fan motor
components.does: Outdoor fan motor, DC 120 W (CN-FM1). A locked fan gives F15: check the fan turns freely and isn't iced up.

components.name: Outdoor main PCB
components.does: Outdoor unit main circuit board.

components.name: Outdoor terminal board
components.does: Terminals 1 2 3 and earth for the connecting cable from the tank unit (4 x 2.5 mm²). Earth wire longer than the others.
